newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns AA+r to A$1 billion SBCWA notes.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns AA+r to A$1 billion SBCWA notes.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Thursday it had assigned its AA+r rating to the A$1.0 billion SBCWA Composite Mirror notes issued by SBCWA Composite Mirror Trust.
SBC Warburg Australia structured and arranged the transaction.

S&P said the 'r' reflected the non-credit risk related to the debt. It said the "AA-plus-r" rating of the notes reflected the rating of the underlying assets and the rating of SBC Warburg's parent Swiss Bank Corp (SBC).

The ratings agency said the rating also reflected the obligation of SBC under the put options to purchase the underlying assets at par to ensure the noteholders will receive adequate funds upon maturity.
SBC Warburg Australia expects to launch the first tranche of the notes in late November.
